newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources invests Colombia plant.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources invests Colombia plant.

text.p: Western Resources said on Wednesday its Wing Group subsidiary would invest in a $80 million, 160-megawatt natural gas fired power plant in Barrancabermeja, Colombia.

Conoco Global Power Inc, a power project development unit of DuPont Co's Conoco Inc, and Sindicato Antioqueno, a private Colombian industrial and financial group, were also investing in the plant, the company said.
The plant, developed by Merrill International Inc was expected to start commercial operations in December 1997, Western Resources said.

The three main holdings of the Sindicato are Suramericana de Construcciones, a unit of Colombian insurance company Suramericana de Seguras, Cementos Argos and Nacional de Chocalates. Corfinsura and reinsurance company Reaseguradora de Colombia would also invest, Western said.
Western said the investment group would function uner the Colombian public services company Merilectrica.
Construction of the plant would start immediately under a turnkey contract with Westinghouse, which will supervise work by Colombian contractor Tipiel, it said.
